semiconductor_relevance: High — Rightleder provides critical ultrapure water and chemical solutions necessary for semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Rightleder (Shanghai) Technology Co., Ltd specializes in advanced water treatment and chemical solutions for the semiconductor industry. They produce electronic grade ultrapure water and essential chemicals like hydrofluoric acid, sulfuric acid, hydrogen peroxide, and ammonia, which are crucial for chip fabrication and integrated circuit manufacturing. Their zero-discharge wastewater treatment technologies support sustainable manufacturing practices.
capabilities: Seawater desalination and municipal water supply
